Moon Dregs — Cursed Technique Reversal (Sun Dregs)

You have unlocked your reversal. You can use your action to spend 10 cursed energy to summon a Jellyfish shikigami, which lasts for 8 hours and uses your proficiency bonus. You cannot have Sun Dregs and Moon Dregs summoned at the same time until you reach 18th level. At 6th level, Sun Dregs can make 2 attacks and does not provoke opportunity attacks from a creature they have made a melee attack against that turn. When Sun Dregs is destroyed, you cannot summon it again for 2 minutes.

jjk5e.automationNotes: Not alongside Moon Dregs before 18th. 2 attacks at 6th. Destroyed: 2 minutes before resummoning.
